item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-fdf669757f917103","start_unit":2,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"On 22 November 2023, the World Bank stated that its portfolio in the Democratic Republic of the Congo had not been suspended, contrary to reports in some media outlets.","question_ids":["5B.7","7B.1","7B.2"],"polarity":"exculpatory","period_fit":"Directly within 2023; concerns an official clarification of the government's external financing relationship.","ruler_attribution":"The statement concerns the government during Tshisekedi's presidency but does not attribute the reported media claims or clarification personally to Tshisekedi.","limitations":["The source does not identify the media reports, explain their origin, or provide broader evidence about transparency of economic information."]},{"source_id":"SRC-d582b37bd0f2b917","start_unit":1,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"In May 2023, the DRC government dissolved the Social Fund, the legal entity implementing three World Bank-financed projects covering gender-based-violence prevention and response, eastern recovery, and stabilization and recovery in eastern DRC, and created a new entity with the same designation. The World Bank and DRC authorities were working on transition arrangements, and disbursements were paused pending those arrangements to minimize disruption and harm to beneficiaries.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.5","6B.6","8B.6","8B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly within 2023 and concerns implementation of active social-protection, gender-based-violence, and eastern-recovery programs.","ruler_attribution":"The source attributes the institutional change to the DRC government and describes cooperation with DRC authorities; it does not state that Tshisekedi personally ordered it.","limitations":["The source does not provide the reasons for dissolution, the duration of the pause, or eventual outcomes for beneficiaries."]},{"source_id":"SRC-99de140794c71658","start_unit":3,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"On 24 May 2023, the DRC's electoral commission (CENI) issued a call for applications and terms of reference for an external audit mission of the 2022–2023 electoral register.","question_ids":["4B.1","4B.4","4B.6","4B.10","8B.2"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly within 2023 and concerns preparation for the 2023 electoral process.","ruler_attribution":"The action is attributed to CENI, an electoral institution, not personally to Tshisekedi; the source does not establish presidential control or independence of the audit.","limitations":["The supplied units do not include the audit terms, auditor selection, findings, or whether recommendations were implemented."]},{"source_id":"SRC-34f0bb2675e69504","start_unit":1,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"The IAEA country record shows that the DRC was party to the Convention on the Physical Protection of Nuclear Material from 21 October 2004, had signed but not ratified the Convention on Early Notification of a Nuclear Accident and the Convention on Assistance in the Case of a Nuclear Accident or Radiological Emergency, and accepted the AFRA regional technical-cooperation agreement on 27 September 2023. It also records an NPT safeguards agreement in force since 9 November 1972 and an Additional Protocol signed in 2003.","question_ids":["1B.4","1B.10"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The AFRA acceptance falls within 2023; the other treaty statuses are historical background still applicable during 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The record concerns the DRC as a state and does not attribute any treaty action to Tshisekedi personally.","limitations":["The supplied record does not show implementation, funding, inspections, safety performance, or any presidential decision during 2023."]},{"source_id":"SRC-8b974ae5d0e5910c","start_unit":3,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"For fiscal year 2023, the Ministry of Budget published instructions for executing Finance Law No. 22/071, documents detailing revenue-generating acts and expenditure credits, a draft budget, a medium-term budget framework for 2023–2025, and a budget-risk statement.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.3","5B.6","5B.7","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly concerns the 2023 budget cycle and execution framework.","ruler_attribution":"The materials were published by the Ministry of Budget; the supplied text does not establish which elements Tshisekedi personally directed or whether the budget was fully executed.","limitations":["The units do not provide budget amounts, execution rates, spending composition, audit findings, or service outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-e9b06eada6b6bc45","start_unit":2,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"The Ministry of Finance's formal allocation of responsibilities includes monetary, tax, customs, debt, public-spending, accounting, audit, external borrowing authorization, and international financial-cooperation functions.","question_ids":["5B.3","5B.5","5B.7","8B.2","8B.5"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"The page describes the ministry's institutional remit applicable during the period but provides no dated 2023 action or result.","ruler_attribution":"The responsibilities are assigned institutionally to the Ministry of Finance, without evidence that Tshisekedi personally exercised or altered them in 2023.","limitations":["This is a formal mandate, not evidence of implementation, staffing, enforcement, or outcomes."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":["SRC-3c053c4be1098c99","SRC-ebc00b0ae8a97132","SRC-06a639326c16b255","SRC-895c4c7cb2f6e902","SRC-ad50b0603ccc38b0","SRC-3a12e08941aacacf"],"batch_limitations":["Most supplied documents are institutional landing pages or metadata rather than substantive 2023 evidence.","The supplied materials generally describe actions by government ministries, CENI, or other institutions and do not establish personal decisions, control, or accountability by Félix Tshisekedi.","No supplied document provides complete implementation outcomes, independent evaluations, or quantified 2023 results for the identified programs or policies."]}
